# Pinned Mobile-Agent execution source

MIT upstream https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent at 81fa28b564ef7a695521500bc15a0e1324b2b394, Mobile-Agent-v3.5/mobile_use. See manifest.json for original and vendored hashes.

run_gui_owl_1_5_for_mobile.py and packages.py are byte-identical. utils.py changes only eager imports: postponed annotations, removal of unused numpy typing import, unused qwen smart_resize import (local smart_resize already shadows it), and eager OpenAI import (original wrapper is replaced by our bounded Responses transport). The original wrapper is not used. The original main, SYSTEM_PROMPT, build_messages/history, parse_action, rescale_coordinates, smart_resize, annotation bodies are unchanged and executed.

aiqa.adapters.mobile_agent_upstream injects model and ADB I/O ports into the imported original runner and executes main in a dedicated CLI process. No replacement planning loop. Device writes use typed argv, per-step evidence, no unknown re-send; model port has no retry. Upstream normalized/resized coordinates are transformed to physical pixels before dispatch. The unmanaged original shell/IME/app resolver paths are not called. Original output directory names are restricted to a new isolated directory. Optional dependencies: pip install -e ".[mobile-agent]".

Luna adaptation is I/O, not a replacement planner: each sent screenshot is resized to1000x1000 to match the original normalized tool frame; original full-resolution evidence remains intact. Responses structured output constrains exactly one original action. The codec renders that action into the original Action/tool_call syntax, which the original parser and main execute. Commentary and final_answer phases are separated; only the final action enters upstream history, with assistant phase preserved in subsequent Responses requests. Both raw responses and actual normalized model images are retained.

An extra observed driver fence checks geometry/foreground and a uniquely identified clickable resource at the unchanged tap point (package/class/id/bounds/text/description), or bounded pixels when no stable ID is available. Replay never relocates the coordinate or calls a model. The manifest pins serial/AVD/package/completion/source SHA and before-image/hierarchy SHA; partial or changed recordings are refused. This is not normal management-server approval/admission integration.
